name: security-accessibility-source-contract
rules: Every requirement touching security must map to at least one security-source registry entry.
Every requirement touching accessibility must preserve an independently verifiable accessibility property.
A source mapping never upgrades implementation state.
Blob SHA and repository ref must be retained for imported source claims.
Unknown, blocked, environment and regression states remain non-passing.
acceptance: A control is complete only when its security property and accessibility property are both implemented and independently evidenced.
blocking_rule: Missing any required evidence item keeps the affected control non-passing.
